title: The Shōjō
subtitle: Mission 04 — Baltimore Inner Harbor
synopsis: A drunk sea spirit is feeding on human emotion at the Baltimore Inner Harbor. Three civilians dead in five days. The spirit came over with a grief-soaked sake cask shipped by Hosokawa Shipping; it is bound to the cask and cannot stop drinking. Veritas modelled the case six weeks ago and has accelerated CAMPBELL’s attention to it specifically to pull the field team out of position.
previously_on: After the events at the Meridian Theatre, Daniel Ashworth was discharged this morning, recovering. The prompt book is in shielded study at the lab. The MESA BIM array was returned per the Aldermoor agreement. Dr. Leech is uneasy about the weekend ahead; multiple campaign threads are coming due. Sven was assigned earlier today to support a parallel deployment, leaving the field team three-handed for the new case.

readaloud.title: Theresa’s Statement — The Third Stool
readaloud.body: Five days ago. Tuesday night. Rusty’s, on Pratt Street. The bartender is named Theresa and she has been working this bar for nineteen years. The man on the third stool got a call at 8:47pm. He held the phone away from his ear, looked at it like it was a small bird, and started laughing. Theresa thought he’d won the lottery. She brought him a beer he hadn’t ordered. He laughed harder. By 8:52, the people at the bar were laughing with him. By 8:54, the people at the booths had come over. Nobody knew what was funny. Everybody was laughing. The man on the third stool laughed for almost six minutes. The crowd laughed with him. The man’s face was red and then it was wet and then he slumped forward onto the bar still smiling. They all said the same thing afterwards. They had never been happier.

readaloud.title: Arrival at the Inner Harbor
readaloud.body: The Inner Harbor is working on a Friday afternoon. Tourists at the aquarium, joggers on the promenade, a cluster of corporate types queuing at the Hosokawa barge for the evening reception. Further east, the commercial quays grind through the day shift — container cranes, diesel trucks, the smell of salt and bunker fuel. There is fog off the water. It is earlier than usual for the season. Nobody local has noticed yet. They will.

readaloud.title: Dusk — The Field Activates
readaloud.body: The fog comes in faster than it should. The temperature drops six degrees in twenty minutes. The sodium lights along the quay flicker on one by one, and each one is haloed in amber for longer than it should be. Whatever you were feeling a moment ago, you are about to feel more of it.

readaloud.title: First Sight — Between the Containers
readaloud.body: Between the container stacks at the eastern end of the Hosokawa quay, in the densest part of the fog, something moves. Tall. Taller than the containers, almost. Red — not blood-red, not fire-red, the red of weathered cinnabar. Swaying. Singing in a voice that is too low for the throat that should be making it. The fog around it is sweeter than fog should be. The air thickens. Whatever you were about to feel, you are about to feel more of it.

readaloud.title: Veritas Arrives
readaloud.body: Headlights cut through the fog at the western end of the quay. Two transit vans. They park in formation, doors open in sequence, and four people in plain dark tactical gear get out without hurry. They have moved like this before. They are armed. They are also professional, which means they walk forward instead of running, and they hold their hands visible until they are within speaking distance. The lead operative — short, broad, thirties, a comm earpiece you can see — stops ten metres out and lifts a tablet. “PORTAL field team. We are authorised to take possession of the cedar cask in your custody. Step away from the artefact and we’ll be out of here in five minutes. We are not here for you. We are here for the object.”

readaloud.title: The Confrontation
readaloud.body: Late evening. The fog has thickened to the point where the sodium lights of the dockyard are amber smears. The Shōjō is in the fog, swaying. Singing. The song is different now — slower, with more silence inside it. If the cask is with you, it hums in answer. If not, the Shōjō is moving, looking for the only thing that tasted right. Whatever is going to happen has to happen here.

handouts.title: Previously on PORTAL
handouts.body: Daniel Ashworth was discharged this morning. He doesn’t remember most of the last fortnight. The prompt book is in Lab 3 under shielded study. Sven was pulled aside by Dr. Leech earlier today and assigned to a separate deployment. The Veritas BIM array was returned per the Aldermoor agreement. The CAMPBELL integrity test from last week has not yet yielded a signal. The other threads are not quiet.

handouts.title: CAMPBELL // Priority Override — Case D
handouts.body: LOCATION: Baltimore Inner Harbor — within 400m of waterfront. TRIGGER: 3 civilian deaths in 5 days, pattern clinical. CLINICAL PRESENTATION: All three victims observed in extreme emotional state immediately before death. No physical trauma. No toxin. No organic cause. BIM SIGNATURE: Confirmed. Atypical. Does not match any recorded class. No engineered markers. CAMPBELL ASSESSMENT: Entity presence highly probable. Pattern suggests escalation. Recommend immediate field deployment. CONFIDENCE: 73%.
handouts.classification: CAMPBELL // Anomaly Report — Case D — IMMINENT

handouts.title: Director’s Note (verbal, in person)
handouts.body: Two hours each way. Get there before sundown if you can. The deaths are getting closer together — if a fourth happens tonight, it’ll be on us. Resolve it fast. And get back — I need you here this weekend. The other threads are not quiet. I’d rather not say more on the open channel.
handouts.classification: DR. V. LEECH — in person, lab common room, 14:30 EST

handouts.title: BPD Case File 2005-1147 — Inner Harbor Cluster
handouts.body: Detective Pulaski’s working file. Three victims, witness statements, ME reports. ME has no cause of death for any of the three. Pulaski has attached Mariana Costa’s statement against captain’s instruction.
handouts.classification: Recovered from Det. R. Pulaski, Central District precinct

handouts.title: M. Costa — Witness Statement & Sketch
handouts.body: Mariana’s account in her own hand, with a ballpoint sketch of the figure she saw between D-7 and D-8. Three sighting locations marked, each closer to the barge than the last.
handouts.classification: Recovered from M. Costa, Hosokawa quay

handouts.title: Letter from Akira Tachibana — Tachibana Brewery
handouts.body: Personal letter sent with the shipment, addressed to the Hosokawa cultural attaché. Sealed until Yuki opens it. Translated by Yuki Tanaka. The brewer wrote it knowing the cask was charged.
handouts.classification: Opened by Y. Tanaka, Hosokawa barge

handouts.title: Inner Harbor — Death Site Map
handouts.body: Hand-marked map showing the three death sites, Mariana’s sightings, the Hosokawa barge, and the Shōjō’s estimated 400m field range.

handouts.title: Recovered Tablet — Op. WHITECEDAR
handouts.body: Veritas operational brief recovered from a downed grunt. Confirms the orchestration: PORTAL was lured to Baltimore, the dockworker mob was pre-shaped by Veritas months earlier, parallel ops were running concurrent with the Baltimore deployment.
handouts.classification: Recovered, Hosokawa quay loading bay — only available if team takes a grunt down

handouts.title: Long-range radio — Leech
handouts.body: Field team, Leech. The secondary deployment — they’re on the ground from the mission. Veritas is already there with paperwork. Sven is with them. They’re holding. If you finish in Baltimore tonight, we may still be able to act. Acknowledge.

handouts.title: Long-range radio — Leech (second call)
handouts.body: Field team, Leech. We’ve lost contact with the secondary team. Last we heard, Veritas had brought a second shift on-site. Sven is still in the building, last reported. I don’t have confirmation of anyone else. Resolve Baltimore and come home. I do not want to be saying this twice.

handouts.title: Long-range radio — Leech (drive home)
handouts.body: Field team. Welcome back. The secondary deployment is over. I’ll brief you in person. Sven is — Sven is safe. Ish. We have things to discuss. Drive carefully. We’ve all earned the morning.
handouts.classification: Suburban long-range radio, early morning, driving north

handouts.title: CAMPBELL — Post-resolution Note
handouts.body: Case D resolved. Shōjō incident logged as natural-source BIM event, first of its class on file. Cask retained / released [adjust per resolution]. Field team report attached. Note: Case D timing analysis underway. Acceleration of CAMPBELL alert window appears irregular. Investigating internally.
handouts.classification: CAMPBELL // Internal note, not in field summary

scans.title: Rusty’s — Third Stool
scans.body: Atypical signature. Residual class. Faint. Five-day fade. Same class as Pier 5, weaker. Cross-reference: same entity.

scans.title: Pier 5 — Eleanor Whitmore’s Bench
scans.body: Atypical signature. Residual class. Mid-strength. Three-day fade. Same class as Rusty’s, stronger. Cross-reference: same entity.

scans.title: Hosokawa Quay — D-7/D-8
scans.body: Atypical signature. Residual class. Strongest of the three sites. One-day fade. Closest match to active cask reading. Cross-reference: same entity, three deaths.

scans.title: Storage Hold A — Cask 3 (Tachibana)
scans.body: Atypical signature, active source. Class unprecedented. Broadband, low fundamental, rough — unlike Aldermoor or prompt-book signatures. Two-way connection detected (cask ↔ entity, ~700m range). This is the cursed cask.

scans.body: No BIM activity. Standard ceremonial sake.

scans.body: Cask signature spikes ~6x baseline at sunset. Field activation event. Entity surfacing.

scans.title: Shōjō — First Close-Range Read
scans.body: Broadband, low fundamental frequency, near-noise. Matches the cask’s low fundamental. First natural-source BIM signature on file. Recording.

tone: The fog comes in faster than it should.
Whatever you were feeling a moment ago, you are about to feel more of it.
The third stool is unoccupied. Nobody sits on it. Nobody will say why.
The bench wants you to stay.
Pulaski’s manila folder has fingerprint smudges along the edges. He has been reading it for five days.
Mariana’s cigarette has burned down without her noticing.
Yuki’s clipboard is impeccably organised and her hands are steady. Her eyes are not.
Six casks in a wooden cradle. Five of them silent. One of them humming.
The sodium lights are haloed in amber for too long.
A bottle shatters on the canvas of the reception tent.
The lead operative’s hands are visible. They have been visible from the moment he stepped out of the van.
The Shōjō sits down on the dockyard concrete and the fight is over.
Yuki cries quietly, holding the empty cup.

threats.name: The Shōjō
threats.subtitle: Sea spirit — Inner Harbor, Baltimore
threats.motivation: To consume — feeds on intense emotion
threats.armour: 2 (drops to 1 when folklore is understood and brewer’s letter is read; rises to 3 if Stirring Clock fills to 4/4)
threats.harm: 3-harm close (Staggering Blow). 2-harm close, ignore-armour, weird (Emotional Drain). +1 harm vs drunk hunters.
moves: Staggering Blow — 3-harm close, wide swing, slow telegraph.
The Singing — soft move; Act Under Pressure or be pulled one move toward the creature.
Amplify the Room — once per fight; intensifies whatever everyone present is feeling.
Drinks what is real — transparent to performed emotion, illusion, glamour. Genuine emotion is visible and drinkable.

custom_moves.name: Drink With the Spirit
custom_moves.trigger: When you share sake with the Shōjō with genuine emotion, roll +Weird.
custom_moves.ten_plus: It drinks, it understands, it accepts. It returns to the sea. Ask the keeper one question about what it perceived in you.
custom_moves.seven_nine: It drinks, but it’s not satisfied. The keeper tells you its grief. Take −1 forward. The Shōjō is calmer. +1 forward on your next attempt.
custom_moves.miss: It drinks from you instead. 3-harm (ignore-armour). It found something in you it needed more than sake.

custom_moves.name: Share the Cup
custom_moves.trigger: If you stay within close range of the Shōjō for more than one round, roll +Cool.
custom_moves.ten_plus: You feel its grief but hold yourself.
custom_moves.seven_nine: The sorrow is overwhelming. Take −1 forward.
custom_moves.miss: You’re inside it. 2-harm (ignore-armour, weird). Cannot act against it until pulled out.

threats.notes: Bound to the Tachibana cask. Tracks the cask wherever it goes. Distance does not break the bond. Stirring Clock tracks pre-climax agitation; Encounter Clock tracks fight progression. Best resolution: Drink With the Spirit using the brewer’s sake and letter. Strong resolution: containment in the cask. Bad: cask destroyed, spirit loose.

threats.name: Veritas Field Squad
threats.subtitle: Four operatives, prophylactic Substance Θ
threats.motivation: Complete the objective, withdraw clean, no incident report.
threats.harm: 2-harm close (baton, restraint). 3-harm close (Anchor Spike, lead only). 3-harm close/far (firearm, only if team draws first).
moves: Overwhelm — two grunts together count as 3-harm; Act Under Pressure to avoid restraint.
Hold the Line — don’t break, one down others close.
Θ prophylactic — immune to the Shōjō’s field; peripheral artefacts near active BIM, exploitable.
Flank for the Cask — two grunts disengage to reach the cask, mission first.
Anchor Spike (lead only, one use) — 3-harm close vs entities, forces contact break.
threats.notes: Will negotiate within a narrow band. Will not destroy the cask. Will withdraw if the situation is unwinnable, even without the cask. The lead carries the operational tablet.

threats.name: The Mob
threats.subtitle: Six amplified longshoremen
threats.motivation: Drive the foreigners off our docks.
threats.harm: 1-harm close (fists, bottles). 2-harm close (tire iron, broken bottle, dropped chain).
moves: Pile On — two together count as 2-harm; three or more as 3-harm.
Field-Amplified — inside the Shōjō’s field, ignore the first 1-harm taken (adrenaline + dreamlike conviction).
Righteous Conviction — −1 to Manipulate Someone if Mob Clock at 3/4 or 4/4.
Break Point — dragged 30m+ outside the field, snap out within a round, will not re-engage.
threats.notes: Real human beings under field-induced aggression. Lethal force kills civilian victims; the session does not punish, but it notes. Subdue, don’t kill. Pre-shaped by Veritas (see WHITECEDAR brief).

scenes.name: Hook — Emergency Override
scenes.synopsis: Friday afternoon, the lab. CAMPBELL flags Case D, Director overrides whatever was planned. Sven was pulled aside earlier today for the parallel deployment. Two-hour drive to Baltimore.

scenes.name: Scene 1 — The Inner Harbor by Day
scenes.synopsis: Investigation. Pulaski (the pattern), Mariana (the sighting), Yuki (the folklore + six casks), Rex’s scanner (residuals + the cursed cask). Click moment: it’s a Shōjō, anchored to the cask, the cask is the lever.

scenes.name: Scene 2 — Dusk: Mob and First Sight
scenes.synopsis: Field activates at 5:47pm. Civilian crises (Olivia, Marcus, the Parks). The mob (six longshoremen, Kowalski with a tire iron). The Shōjō visible between D-7 and D-8. First engagement humbles the team.

scenes.name: Scene 3 — Veritas Arrives for the Cask
scenes.synopsis: Four grunts arrive in two transit vans. Negotiate, fight, or hand the cask over. Orchestration revelation lands here. Sven advantage absent (he’s elsewhere); Alan’s fey imprinting is the team’s diplomacy lever now.

scenes.name: Investigation Beat — The Brewer’s Letter
scenes.synopsis: Yuki opens and translates the letter. Rex deploys the sake. Tactical preparation. The team chooses fight, diplomacy, or both.

scenes.name: Climax — The Confrontation
scenes.synopsis: Loading-bay concrete pad. Sake circle, the cask, the brewer’s letter. Three phases. Drink With the Spirit is the best ending; containment is the strong ending.

scenes.name: The Drive Home
scenes.synopsis: Cell coverage returns. Leech on the radio. Sven is ‘safe. Ish.’ The case is closed; the campaign is not. Plant for S05.

tools_in_play: Rex’s BIM scanner (built S03, still unnamed). First natural-source signature this session.
Spirit containment in willing vessels (S03 canon — Clara jar). Open question whether it works on Shōjō.
Catalyst bidirectionality (S03 canon — prompt book). Directly applies to the cask.
Alan’s fey imprinting (S03 canon, costs Fey points). Primary diplomacy lever in Sven’s absence.
Alan’s glamour and shapeshifting. Works on humans. Does not work on the Shōjō.
Suburban long-range radio. Leech’s three calls.
CAMPBELL integrity test (pending S03). No signal yet.
